_doc: The ten groups of the project. Edit HERE; MyTradingSys/system/PROJECT_MAP.md is generated by scripts/dev/make_groups.py. A registry row (BUGS.md) is placed by 'assign' first, then by the group whose keywords match its title and evidence best (ties: the earlier group), else UNGROUPED. A file or folder belongs to the group with the LONGEST matching entry in 'paths'. 'focus' is hand-written, dated, and goes stale: refresh it when you change a group's state.

groups.name: Market data and snapshot engine
groups.scope: The Java feed and snapshot producer, kline / open-interest / order-flow recorders, funding, higher-timeframe context, and the volume profile, VWAP and CVD numbers the snapshot carries.
groups.operator_words: the data from the Java engine
groups.surface: Code session (Sonnet) for Python; Java needs mvn compile and a supervisor restart window
groups.focus: Running. Known defects not yet fixed: Java volume profile does not conserve volume (POC 300-690 points off), snapshot OI is hourly-stepped with 46 h of recorder holes, VWAP anchor says 13:30Z but is 00:00Z, naked-POC list frozen since 2026-08-28 (bigtrade FINDINGS F-BT-09..16). Java fixes wait for a restart window.
groups.tracker: registry rows plus the bigtrade findings F-BT-09..16 (not yet in the registry)

groups.name: Rule sources and extraction
groups.scope: What the traders said and how it becomes a rule: transcripts, extracts, the verbatim-quote gate, provenance (every parameter from a quote or it does not exist), the analyst pipeline.
groups.surface: Code session (Sonnet); extraction judgment by Opus
groups.focus: Tom transcripts still extracting. PROJECT_VISION gap classes 1 and 2 (rule not extracted, extracted wrong) have no coverage mechanism. NO-SOURCE parameters are flagged but not resolved (B117, B142-B145, B153).
groups.tracker: registry rows; there is no extraction-coverage tracker (PROJECT_VISION gap classes 1-2)

groups.name: Tom core engine and verdicts
groups.scope: The deterministic rule engine: compiled_engine, condition files, proof counting, setup states (WAIT_PROOF to SETUP_CONFIRMED), net_rr, the math object and start-trading-day.
groups.operator_words: the rules that are coded and applied to the data; Tom is core
groups.surface: Code session (Sonnet) with tests from the spec; live-path files go through the supervisor
groups.focus: Running. Evidence is weak: Tom gross R is -0.15 [-0.29, +0.04] before fees, and the live rule shows 0 signals where an older run on the same history showed 19 (B147). Admission thresholds are unsourced (B117, B153).
groups.tracker: registry rows; SUPERVISOR_LOG.md for live-path claims

groups.name: Independent layers (switchable modules)
groups.scope: Everything that sits on top of Tom and never gates it: RSI / Malkan, CryptoCred, Fabio, session frame, positioning, tick delta, timeframe layer, turn-of-candle, consensus, probability, options (Deribit), WaveTrend, alerts.
groups.operator_words: every other indicator system is a separate layer
groups.surface: Code session (Sonnet); formulas from FORMULAS.md, never from existing code
groups.focus: Built, none proven: 0 of 34 layer/side rows reach lift 1.15 at 96 bars with r 1.5, k 3 (capture matrix 2026-10-09). turn_of_candle is 79 % of live testnet trades but failed its backtest (F-BT-02, awaiting an operator yes/no). Freeze on new layers stands until B146-B148 report.
groups.tracker: registry rows plus the bigtrade capture matrix (lift per layer and side)

groups.name: Backtest and evidence
groups.scope: The harness, trial registry, holdouts, the big-trade study and capture matrix, and the research questions we answer with data (hypothesis queue).
groups.operator_words: back test so layers fire on big, profitable trades
groups.surface: Code session (Sonnet); verdict wording by Opus; one HOLDOUT look per layer
groups.focus: Big-move ground truth (A), kline fire history (B1), capture matrix and exit policies (C) are done; order-flow fires (B2), walk-forward tuning (D), gap list (E) and chart observations (F) are not. Operator 2026-10-09: tune layers toward big profitable trades, labelled BT-TUNED, never written to live files by a worker.
groups.tracker: the registry has almost no rows for this group: progress is the bigtrade PLAN.md steps A-F and FINDINGS.md

groups.name: Execution and risk (Deribit testnet)
groups.scope: Everything that places or protects an order: auto_trader, position_manager, daily-loss monitor, orphan watchdog, deribit_orders, runner, kill switch, fee model, subaccounts.
groups.surface: Code session writes in a worktree; ONLY the supervisor deploys, restarts, touches HALT files or opens trades
groups.focus: Testnet live: 333 closed trades 2026-09-28..10-08. Requested first by the supervisor (2026-10-09): B148 daily-loss monitor re-authenticates as MAIN, B146 no minimum stop width, B147. All still OPEN.

groups.name: Charts, screenshots and observation
groups.scope: The operator's eyes: TradingView and CoinGlass charts, footprint and heatmap panels, random screenshots with a meaning, missed-trade capture, the chart-read method. Finds what the data pipeline misses.
groups.operator_words: screenshots are a completely different view
groups.surface: Any session via the hook; chart sets read by Sonnet or better
groups.focus: Intake pipeline built 2026-10-09 (scripts/dev/shot.py, hook, template). 22 images recovered into the store: 9 non-charts closed, 13 charts classified and not closed (9 analysed by the bigtrade study but not yet linked, 4 from 2026-10-02 never read). Standing gaps: operator drawings are stored nowhere, T066 (read TradingView layouts) blocked since 2026-10-05, DSA chat cannot save images, the hook is active only after the supervisor deploys it to the live tree.
groups.tracker: the registry has no rows for this group yet: progress is `python scripts/dev/shot.py status` (also the Screenshots block of STATUS.md)

groups.name: Operator interface (DSA and live desk)
groups.scope: How the operator talks to the system: the DSA chat surface and its prompt, the live-desk helper, session paste, trading cards, user guide, launcher commands.
groups.operator_words: DSA, the desk, what I see when I ask
groups.surface: DSA (chat) plus Code sessions that edit the prompt files; prompt changes are size-budgeted and eval-gated
groups.focus: DSA slim boot + eval shipped 2026-10-09 (commit 02e7598). B132 (DSA dispatches everything to Claude Code) is open. A screenshot rule for DSA waits as DSA_SESSION_PROMPT.md.pending_patch_2026-10-09_screenshots.md.

groups.name: AI workforce and process
groups.scope: How the work gets done: surfaces and session naming, scheduler and pick_task, sync.py and parallel worktrees, workers (NUC retired, AIBridge), cloud credits, test gate, CI, lessons learned, supervisor log, item registry.
groups.operator_words: sessions, workers, budget, who does what
groups.surface: Opus supervisor decides; Code sessions execute
groups.focus: NUC/Qwen lane retired 2026-10-01; AIBridge is the run-command surface; every session works in its own worktree and ships with sync.py. Open: B150 test gate is a hand-kept allow-list, B090 cloud credit plan, B095 per-session cost not on disk. Freeze on new audit documents until B146-B148 report.

groups.name: Machines, runtime plumbing, housekeeping
groups.scope: The computers and the plumbing under everything: desktop / NUC / laptop, supervisor and launchers, disk health, the Dumps share, retention, backups, archive.
groups.operator_words: the machine, the stack is down
groups.surface: Operator and supervisor; hardware work is the operator's
groups.focus: B140 desktop WHEA hardware errors every 1-3 days since 2026-07-19 (HIGH, SMART unread, live java runs from D:). B138 Dumps diverged between C: and F:. B152 retention.py deletes files other tools read.
groups.tracker: registry rows; the supervisor's loop health in STATUS.md
